description: MINE for Facebook is a Facebook client created with one mission in mind: your Facebook experience, the way you want it. Of course you can see your Facebook timeline, see and respond to your private messages, post updates, comment & like, view albums, events, groups, pages, ..., but you can go one step further if you wish. We've included a bunch of extra feeds, which allow you to see more than what is regularly shown in your news feed. Ever wanted to see all the photo's your friends post?
